title: Wielandt subgroups of nilpotent residuals and Fitting-height bounds
summary: For a finite group $G$, let $\mathrm W(G)$ be the intersection of the normalizers of the nilpotent residuals of the subnormal subgroups of $G$, and let $\ell_{\mathrm W}(G)$ be the length of the associated upper series. Thus $\mathrm W(G)=G$ exactly when all these residuals are normal in $G$. We prove that every finite soluble group satisfies $\ell_{\mathrm W}(G)\le h(G)\le4\ell_{\mathrm W}(G)$, where $h(G)$ is the Fitting height, and that $h(G)\le3\ell_{\mathrm W}(G)$ if $|G|$ is odd or the Sylow $2$-subgroups of $G$ are abelian.
